joint_position_limits.applicability: Reference intervals only; actual controller profile and mounting can impose additional limits.

mounting_couplings: Tilt up to 30 deg: J1 restricted to +/-45 deg.
Wall mounting: J1 restricted to +/-20 deg.
Restricting J1 to +/-100 deg permits J2 [-63,136] deg on the 1.2 m variant; not enabled here.
J4/J6 extended rotations are software dependent and physically limited by paint hoses; not enabled here.

task_constraint.scenario_zh: 专用喷涂机器人正对竖直面喷涂
task_constraint.scenario_en: Dedicated paint robot facing a vertical surface
task_constraint.estimate_rationale_zh: 假定地面安装并从 -Y 侧正向喷涂，15 度全局方向锥与 10 度法向入射容差均为工艺估计；不是 ABB 给出的喷涂角度。

world_position_constraint.estimate_rationale_zh: 工作面中心水平偏置 0.8 m、相对底座安装面高度 0.4 m；圆形工作窗口半径 0.2 m。按名义臂展预留余量选取的布局初值，不是最大可达面积。移动工作面后须重新评估窗口。

task_constraint.note_zh: 方向锥、底座与工作窗口固定在用户世界坐标；移动工件不会自动移动这些约束。TCP 定义在实际工具的工作端；当前工具长度与安装姿态为估计，须用实际标定替换。

tcp_to_surface_distance_m.rationale_zh: 假定安装常规空气雾化喷枪；Graco Automatic XT 手册建议喷嘴距表面 150–200 mm，并近法向喷涂。180 mm 为本项目初值，非 ABB 本体限制。

base_pose_world.note_zh: 位置为底座安装面中心；估计底座 +X 指向工件的水平投影，+Z 向上，未做实物标定。

tcp_transform.note_zh: 假定直工具沿法兰 +Z，TCP 位于工作端（磨头接触面、探针尖端、针头、镜头前端或喷嘴）；实际夹具、工具及 TCP 须重新标定。

unmodeled: payload center of mass and inertia

sources.title: ABB IRB 52 datasheet IRB52_DATASHEET_USL_06.2017, 1.2 m version
sources.note: Nominal 1.2 m reach variant (drawing radius R1225 mm). Default floor-mounted ranges; wall/tilted mounting changes allowable axis 1. Hose limits remain relevant.

sources.title: Universal Robots manual: Operating Space
sources.note: Explains position-dependent orientation restrictions, outer reach and the central restricted cylinder. Does not prescribe the station offsets or work-window radii used here, including for other brands.

sources.title: Graco Automatic XT Spray Guns, 311051C, page 17
sources.note: Automatic air-spray process reference: perpendicular, 150–200 mm from the surface. Applicability depends on the installed spray gun and coating, not the ABB robot model.
